subject: Fix duplicate label handling (#1283)
reason: The change fixes HNSW duplicate-label handling in two paths, both unreachable by valkey-fuzzer. (1) The modify-path fix (vector_hnsw.cc ModifyRecordImpl dropping markDelete, and hnswalg.h addPoint reusing an existing label's slot) only changes behavior when allow_replace_deleted_ is true. That comes from search.hnsw-allow-replace-deleted, a .Dev() config that is Hidden+Immutable unless search.debug-mode yes, which is settable only via module load-time args; the fuzzer loads modules by bare path with no args, so the config stays at its default false. In default config both builds call updatePoi
